item_catalog.description: A physical manifestation of a cultural truth, forged in silver and coral. Grants the bearer innate trust in maritime negotiations.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A silver sculpture of a wave intertwined with a stylized tongue, encrusted with small pearls.

item_catalog.description: A scroll made of dried kelp that translates the subsonic vibrations of deep-sea entities into readable script.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A dark green kelp scroll with glowing neon runes, dripping with phantom seawater.

item_catalog.description: A heavy stone seal that, when pressed, magically prevents any party from speaking of the agreement's terms.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A heavy basalt stamp with a finger-to-lips icon carved in glowing sapphire.

item_catalog.name: Cultural Debt Tally Stone
item_catalog.description: A porous rock that grows heavier as the owner's social obligations to the Embassy increase.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A grey volcanic rock with glowing orange veins that pulse like a heartbeat.

item_catalog.name: Echoing Conch of Lost Greetings
item_catalog.description: A shell that plays back the first words ever spoken by a dead civilization when held to the ear.
item_catalog.image_prompt: An iridescent spiral conch shell emitting a faint golden mist from its opening.

item_catalog.name: Ink of the Inkless Squid
item_catalog.description: A rare fluid used to write secrets that can only be read when submerged in seawater.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A small ceramic pot containing swirling, invisible liquid that shimmers like oil on water.

item_catalog.name: Forged Idiom: 'Blood is Brine'
item_catalog.description: A heavy iron anchor charm that binds two families together in a permanent, unbreakable alliance.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A rusted iron anchor miniature wrapped in glowing red seaweed.

item_catalog.description: A small cork talisman that allows the wearer to understand metaphors involving height and depth.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A carved cork pendant shaped like a bubble, floating slightly above a wooden table.

item_catalog.name: Vial of Storm-Tossed Sarcasm
item_catalog.description: A volatile liquid used to add a biting, ironic edge to formal declarations.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A jagged glass bottle containing a miniature swirling grey thunderstorm.

item_catalog.name: Seal of the Rising Tide
item_catalog.description: A massive jade seal used to authorize the flooding of lower archive chambers during emergencies.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A large square jade block with a wave motif, glowing with a soft green light.

item_catalog.name: Debt-Bonded Pearl
item_catalog.description: A black pearl representing a life-debt owed to the High Archivist. It glows when the debt is called.
item_catalog.image_prompt: A perfectly spherical black pearl resting on a silk cushion, emitting a faint violet aura.

item_catalog.name: Scroll of the Unspoken Vow
